source: Polymarket: terminal.discover across the volume / closing / new / volatility columns. Kalshi: the public series list plus /events?series_ticker=...&with_nested_markets, read-only.
labelling: expectedKalshiTicker is the ONE Kalshi market that asks the same question — same subject, same resolution date, same threshold, same direction. null means no genuine equivalent exists, which is the common and correct answer for most Polymarket questions. A near miss (different window, different threshold, different fixture) is labelled null on purpose.
